Dave Walden

Vice President of Platform and Reliability

[Linkedin](https://gomomentus.com/authors/dave-walden#)

Dave Walden is Vice President of Platform and Reliability at Momentus Technologies. He leads the Platform Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering teams and owns the customer experience across the company’s platforms. A technology leader for more than 25 years, Dave champions modern engineering practices and builds teams that thrive on change. He speaks internationally on cloud and data platforms and lives in Kansas City, Missouri.
